title: Americans with Disabilities Act – ADA (Luật Người khuyết tật)

versions.text:
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) – 42 USC §12101 et seq.
Title I: Employment. Prohibits discrimination against qualified individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodation requirement. Undue hardship defense.
Title II: Public services (state and local government).
Title III: Public accommodations and services operated by private entities.
Title IV: Telecommunications.
Title V: Miscellaneous provisions.
